sentences.text:
Petiti
 Through: Mr. Nitin Kaushik, Advocate.

versus
 The State Nct Of Delhi & Anr. .....

Responden
 Through: Mr. Nawal Kishore Jha, App for St
 with Si Priyanka.

Ms. Kajal Sahu, Advocate for  respondent no.2.
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 02.09.2025 CRL.M.A. 10205/2025 (exemption)
1.
Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 814/2015 of PS Samaipur Badli for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
3. There are serious allegations in the FIR to the effect that the petitioners assaulted respondent no.2 with the clear intent to cause forcible miscarriage.
It appears that learned APP was not briefed about this fact.
On being asked about the IO, the police official present, SI Priyanka discloses that IO is ASI Jagbir Singh, PS S.P. Badli, but he has not appeared with the chargesheet.
SI Priyanka submits that she is the "deputed" IO.
But she is unable to explain as to what is deputed IO.

Further,
SI Priyanka, not being the IO, is not aware as to what investigation was carried out in relation to the This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 02/09/2025 at 22:49:18 allegation of forced abortion of respondent no.2.
4.
It has been repeatedly directed that IOs should remain present in court with the records and in their absence, SHOs must appear.
Repeatedly, copies of orders were sent to the concerned DCPs and finally even to the Commissioner of Police.
But to no avail.

5. Under these circumstances, costs of Rs.5000/- is imposed on IO/ASI Jagbir Singh of PS S.P.
Badli for failure to appear to explain regarding the investigation, if any, carried out qua forced abortion of respondent no.2.
The said costs shall be deposited by ASI Jagbir Singh with DHCLSC within one week and on next date, there shall be no further default.

sentences.text: Relist on 19.11.2025.
GIRISH KATHPALIA, J SEPTEMBER 2, 2025/ry 7.
At this stage, matter again taken up on oral request of learned APP who has appeared with Inspector Shailender Singh, SHO S.P. Badli.
The SHO explains that IO got transferred to traffic police and could not be informed about this case.
SHO expresses regret and assures that next time there shall be no default in any of the cases pertaining to his police station.
8. Considering the assurance extended by the SHO, costs imposed in the earlier call is recalled.
GIRISH KATHPALIA, J SEPTEMBER 2, 2025/ry
